strategy_roster.name: Bbsr Extreme
strategy_roster.notes: The lower Bollinger(20,2) rebound and EMA(7) trend filter retain the documented numeric settings. ATR(14) 2x/3x protection is dynamic and not a fixed percentage field; EMA(20) is an explicit trend-baseline fallback.

strategy_roster.name: DSL
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(ema(close,34),1) > 0 and bars_since(low > ema(close,34)) < 3 and rsi(close,10) > 30
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(34) and RSI(10) preserve the documented DSL and Beluga lengths; a three-bar persistence test and RSI above oversold approximate the proprietary oscillator. ATR-band stops and the 1.5 risk-reward target are not fixed percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Resampling Filter Pack
strategy_roster.notes: The five-bar ROC of EMA(9) approximates five-bar resampling while retaining the documented sample and MA periods. Stateful sampling is unavailable, and the opposite slope/price state exits; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Color 3rd Generation XMA
strategy_roster.notes: A doubly smoothed EMA(5) approximates the third-generation average, with EMA(20) and slope as fallbacks because no lengths are supplied. Scheduled entry, holding time, and optional point-based protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Kaufman Trend
strategy_roster.notes: Normalized five-bar momentum strength above one and price above EMA(20) proxy the unavailable Kalman filter and threshold 60. The 50/25/25 figures are staged-profit allocations rather than price percentages; swing/ATR stops and timing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Hpcs Inter7
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Bollinger(20,2) outside-band breakout is exact, with middle-band reversion as the long exit proxy. Equal 10-point stop/target protection and the 1-minute timeframe are not fixed percentage/DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Donchian Width Mean Reversion
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish reversal below a two-standard-deviation 20-bar band approximates the documented extreme and turn; the 2% stop is retained. Exact Donchian-width state and channel exit are unavailable, so Bollinger(20,2) is an explicit proxy.

strategy_roster.name: Burg Extrapolator
strategy_roster.notes: Positive ten-bar ROC above 2% is an explicit fallback for a favorable Burg forecast amplitude; volume confirmation is also a fallback. The autoregressive model, forecast high/low thresholds, pip stops, and multi-position risk controls are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Parabolic SAR Flip Alert Strategy (4164)
strategy_roster.notes: The optional auto-trading mode is represented with bullish/bearish EMA(20) crosses as a Parabolic SAR flip proxy; EMA(20) is a fallback because no values are supplied. SAR step/max settings and alert-only behavior cannot be configured in the roster.

strategy_roster.name: RSI Expert
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14) crossing up through the documented 30 oversold level enters long, and 70 exits. Stop, target, and trailing percentages default to zero, so all are left null.
